dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: Did I make her mad or something?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: No, no, darling. I’m sure you didn’t do anything to upset her.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: ..Sometimes we just… have one of those days?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: She pushed me, Liz. I’ve never seen her lash out at me like that.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: Tell you what, I'll take her to school today and ask her about it, okay?
